title: Embedding Responsive Images with and
ques: Explain the essential attributes of the **``** tag (`src`, `alt`, `loading="lazy"`, `width`, `height`). Demonstrate responsive art direction using the **``** element.
explanation: Descriptive `alt` text is critical for accessibility and SEO. Setting `width` and `height` prevents Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS). `<picture>` allows art direction and modern image format delivery (`webp`, `avif`).

title: Embedding Audio with the <audio> Tag
ques: Write an HTML snippet embedding an audio track with standard playback controls, multiple audio source codecs (MP3, OGG), and a fallback notice for older browsers.
explanation: The `<audio controls>` element provides standard play/pause and volume controls natively. `preload="metadata"` fetches file duration without buffering the entire audio payload up front.

title: Embedding Video and Third-Party Media
ques: Compare embedding native HTML5 video with embedding third-party players (like YouTube) via **`<iframe>`**. Write code samples for both.
explanation: Native `<video>` is ideal for self-hosted video assets with complete UI control. `<iframe>` embeds hosted streams from platforms like YouTube or Vimeo with offloaded streaming bandwidth and built-in transcoding.
